settings.text: Sheer-to-medium cover with a fresh, luminous finish. Fine reflective pigments let your own tone come through while mineral SPF 40 guards against sun and blue light.

settings.label: Ingredients
settings.text: A silicone-free base of niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, allantoin and squalane from plants, with non-nano zinc oxide as the SPF filter. No fragrance, no gluten.

settings.label: How to use
settings.text: Shake well, press a half-pipette into your palm and smooth over clean skin. Buff in with a brush for more coverage. Your shade looks lighter at first and settles to true tone in a minute.

settings.label: Step two
settings.title: Smooth on like a serum
settings.text: Use fingertips for sheer cover, or a dense brush to build toward medium.

settings.label: Step three
settings.title: Let the shade settle
settings.text: Color shifts from lighter to true tone within sixty seconds, a cue to apply enough SPF.

settings.label: What makes this different from a tinted moisturizer?
settings.text: Most tinted moisturizers stop at hydration and color. This one adds serum-strength actives and a mineral SPF 40, so it works as skincare, sunscreen and base.

settings.label: How much coverage does it give?
settings.text: Light to medium with a dewy finish. Apply with fingers for sheer wear or a brush for more.

settings.label: Can I wear it over skincare?
settings.text: Yes, but try it on clean skin first: the SPF is designed to be applied as the final skincare step.

settings.label: How do I pick a shade?
settings.text: Use the finder for a recommendation, or compare undertone and depth against the shade guide in natural light.
